chunks.ar: بنت حمامة عشًّا عاليًا في نخلة قرب النهر.
chunks.en_old: A dove built a nest high in a palm tree beside a river.
chunks.en_new: A dove built a nest high in a palm tree beside a river.

chunks.ar: وضعت فيه بيضًا، وانتظرت حتى خرج منه فراخ صغيرة.
chunks.en_old: She laid eggs and waited until little chicks hatched.
chunks.en_new: She laid eggs and waited until little chicks hatched.

chunks.ar: كانت تطعمها كل يوم، ولا تترك العش إلا قليلًا.
chunks.en_old: She fed them each day and rarely left the nest.
chunks.en_new: She fed them each day and rarely left the nest.

chunks.ar: وفي صباح، وقف ثعلب تحت النخلة وصاح:
chunks.en_old: One morning, a fox stood beneath the palm tree and shouted,
chunks.en_new: One morning, a fox stood beneath the palm tree and shouted,

chunks.ar: «أعطيني فرخًا من فراخك، وإلا صعدت إلى الشجرة وأكلتكم جميعًا!»
chunks.en_old: “Give me one of your chicks, or I will climb up and eat all of you!”
chunks.en_new: “Give me one of your chicks, or I will climb up and eat all of you!”

chunks.ar: خافت الحمامة، وظنت أن الثعلب يستطيع الوصول إليها،
chunks.en_old: The dove was frightened. She thought he could reach her,
chunks.en_new: The dove was frightened. She thought he could reach her,

chunks.ar: فرمت إليه فرخًا.
chunks.en_old: so she dropped one chick to him.
chunks.en_new: so she dropped one chick to him.

chunks.ar: عاد الثعلب بعد أيام، وهددها مرة أخرى.
chunks.en_old: The fox came back a few days later and threatened her again.
chunks.en_new: The fox came back a few days later and threatened her again.

chunks.ar: ففعلت الحمامة الشيء نفسه، وحزنت حزنًا شديدًا.
chunks.en_old: The dove did the same thing and was deeply distressed.
chunks.en_new: The dove did the same thing and was deeply distressed.

chunks.ar: رآها طائر مالك الحزين قرب النهر،
chunks.en_old: A heron saw her near the river
chunks.en_new: A heron saw her near the river

chunks.ar: وسألها عن سبب بكائها.
chunks.en_old: and asked why she was crying.
chunks.en_new: and asked why she was crying.

chunks.ar: حكت الحمامة ما جرى، فقال مالك الحزين:
chunks.en_old: The dove told him what had happened. The heron said,
chunks.en_new: The dove told him what had happened. The heron said,

chunks.ar: «الثعلب لا يستطيع تسلق هذه النخلة!
chunks.en_old: “The fox cannot climb this palm tree!
chunks.en_new: “The fox cannot climb this palm tree!

chunks.ar: عندما يعود، قولي له: اصعد إن استطعت.
chunks.en_old: When he returns, tell him to climb if he can.
chunks.en_new: When he returns, tell him to climb if he can.

chunks.ar: لن أعطيك فراخي بيدي بعد اليوم.»
chunks.en_old: You will not hand over your chicks again.”
chunks.en_new: I will not give you my chicks with my own hands after today."
chunks.note: wrong speaker; the dove's words to the fox

chunks.ar: جاء الثعلب في اليوم التالي، وكرر تهديده.
chunks.en_old: The fox came the next day and repeated his threat.
chunks.en_new: The fox came the next day and repeated his threat.

chunks.ar: هذه المرة أجابته الحمامة بثبات:
chunks.en_old: This time the dove answered firmly,
chunks.en_new: This time the dove answered firmly,

chunks.ar: «اصعد أنت إن كنت تستطيع! لن أرمي إليك شيئًا.»
chunks.en_old: “Climb up yourself if you can! I will not throw anything to you.”
chunks.en_new: “Climb up yourself if you can! I will not throw anything to you.”

chunks.ar: تفاجأ الثعلب، وسألها: «من علمك هذا الكلام؟»
chunks.en_old: The fox was surprised and asked, “Who taught you to say that?”
chunks.en_new: The fox was surprised and asked, “Who taught you to say that?”

chunks.ar: قالت الحمامة: «مالك الحزين الذي يعيش عند النهر.»
chunks.en_old: “The heron who lives by the river,” the dove replied.
chunks.en_new: “The heron who lives by the river,” the dove replied.

chunks.ar: ذهب الثعلب إليه، وتظاهر بالإعجاب بذكائه.
chunks.en_old: The fox went to him and pretended to admire his cleverness.
chunks.en_new: The fox went to him and pretended to admire his cleverness.

chunks.ar: سأله: «إذا جاءت الريح من اليمين، أين تضع رأسك؟»
chunks.en_old: “If the wind blows from the right,” he asked, “where do you put your head?”
chunks.en_new: “If the wind blows from the right,” he asked, “where do you put your head?”

chunks.ar: فأجابه الطائر.
chunks.en_old: The bird answered.
chunks.en_new: The bird answered.

chunks.ar: ثم قال الثعلب:
chunks.en_old: Then the fox asked,
chunks.en_new: Then the fox asked,

chunks.ar: «وماذا تفعل إذا جاءت الريح من كل الجهات؟»
chunks.en_old: “And what do you do if the wind comes from every direction?”
chunks.en_new: “And what do you do if the wind comes from every direction?”

chunks.ar: قال مالك الحزين: «أضع رأسي تحت جناحي.»
chunks.en_old: The heron said, “I put my head under my wing.”
chunks.en_new: The heron said, “I put my head under my wing.”

chunks.ar: طلب الثعلب أن يريه كيف يفعل ذلك، فوافق الطائر.
chunks.en_old: The fox asked him to demonstrate, and the bird agreed.
chunks.en_new: The fox asked him to demonstrate, and the bird agreed.

chunks.ar: وما إن أخفى مالك الحزين رأسه تحت جناحه،
chunks.en_old: As soon as the heron tucked his head beneath his wing,
chunks.en_new: As soon as the heron tucked his head beneath his wing,

chunks.ar: حتى قفز عليه الثعلب وأمسك به.
chunks.en_old: the fox leaped on him and caught him.
chunks.en_new: the fox leaped on him and caught him.

chunks.ar: قال ساخرًا: «عرفت كيف تنصح الحمامة، لكنك لم تعرف كيف تحمي نفسك!»
chunks.en_old: “You knew how to advise the dove,” he mocked, “but not how to protect yourself!”
chunks.en_new: “You knew how to advise the dove,” he mocked, “but not how to protect yourself!”

chunks.ar: ثم أكله ومضى، وبقي النهر هادئًا.
chunks.en_old: Then he ate him and went away, leaving the river quiet.
chunks.en_new: Then he ate him and went away, leaving the river quiet.
